name: Solving in Cedar City TN B 2026
information: This competition is part of a series with [Solving in Cedar City TN A 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SolvinginCedarCityTNA2026) taking place the previous day. You are only able to register for and compete in one of the two competitions in the series. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast!
